title: Solar Granules, Intergranular Lanes, and Magnetic Elements of the Quiet Sun
telescope: U.S. National Science Foundation Daniel K. Inouye Solar Telescope, Haleakalā, Maui, Hawaiʻi. Operated by the National Solar Observatory (NSO), managed by AURA.
coordinate_extent: The official source caption describes the full square field as 30,720 km × 30,720 km on the solar photosphere.
appearance: The orange/yellow palette is the observatory’s false-colour presentation of a single blue-visible channel at 450.4 nm. The photospheric convection pattern and bright points are observed.
appearance_ko: 광구에서 뜨거운 플라스마가 솟는 밝은 쌀알과, 식은 플라스마가 내려가는 어두운 경계가 보입니다. 관측소가 가시광 청색 450.4 nm 밝기 영상을 금빛으로 채색했습니다.
